explanation: Despite its name it is not a true eel at all, but a knifefish, closer kin to catfish and carp. It breathes air and must keep rising to the surface to gulp a breath.

claims.text: The electric eel is a knifefish (order Gymnotiformes), not a true eel.
The electric eel is not a true eel, a catfish or a ray.
Knifefishes are more closely related to catfish and carp than to true eels.
Electric eels breathe air and must surface regularly to breathe.

evidence.restatement: The electric eel (genus Electrophorus) is a Neotropical knifefish of the order Gymnotiformes, not a true eel of the order Anguilliformes.
